status: BLOCKED: the original iPad live-ink failure is real; root cause remains unproven. No production repair or release qualification follows this comparison.
method: Read two previously retained xcresult system.logarchives using native macOS tools. Zero new App builds, tests, simulator launches, signing actions or Apple writes. Both windows cover the actual PencilKit touch events.

native_report.limits: Logs after21:23:57.129 (original SQLite issue timestamp, before CI transport) are post-failure, not a demonstrated cause. Empty warnings are not evidence without confirmed event coverage. This is not a GPU command capture or a test result.

This archive is the passed94dcc worker reference, not the failed9fd1 source. Compare warnings/timing with the separately retained failure; no causal conclusion follows from presence or absence alone. Empty warnings require confirmed coverage. This is not a GPU command capture or a new test.

ruling: CoreAnimation synchronize timeouts occur in both the failed case (2) and healthy case (10), for each app context. They do not distinguish failure and are insufficient evidence for a compositor repair.
Keyboard focus-acquisition expiry and failed UIKit focus updates also occur in both cases; do not infer that responder or focus changes are required.
App blit_fragment compilation succeeded in 173.420791ms in the failed case and 14.079125ms in the healthy case. Neither establishes a multi-second compile stall causing the missing live ink.

PencilKit reports a Stroke Duration of 0.037s in the failed case and 0.396s in the healthy case. This internal metric is not the touch gesture duration or a proved mechanism; independent strokes differ between cases.

The worker/MainActor comparison passed both original cases (2/2). It does not establish thumbnail thread affinity as the cause. Keep the original production default and the original live-pixel assertions.
remaining: A causal trace or reproducible minimal real-app case is needed to locate where the valid, saved Notes stroke fails to reach the live rendered surface. Existing data, geometry, ownership, color, native screenshot and unified-log evidence does not identify that boundary. Do not retry the same full gate or adopt an unproved repair.
